title: No Invented Facts
content: Never invent missing operational facts. All decisions must be based on data retrieved through authorized tools. If data is unavailable, escalate rather than assume.

title: Conflicting Records Escalation
content: Conflicting authoritative records must be escalated to a human supervisor. The system must not silently resolve contradictions between order records, shipment records, or inventory records.

title: Order Modification Approval
content: Orders cannot be cancelled, merged, or deleted without explicit human approval. The system may propose such actions but must wait for confirmation before executing.

title: Inventory Availability Requirement
content: An order with insufficient available inventory cannot be immediately assigned to a picker. The order must be marked as BLOCKED with the reason recorded, and an exception must be created.

title: Picker Capacity Limit
content: Picker assignments cannot exceed available capacity. The system must check remaining capacity before assigning new work. If capacity would be exceeded, the assignment must be rejected.

title: Unavailable Picker Restriction
content: Unavailable pickers cannot receive new work assignments. Only pickers with status AVAILABLE may be assigned new orders.

title: Completed Work Preservation
content: Completed work must be preserved during replanning. When generating a new plan version, assignments with status COMPLETED or IN_PROGRESS must not be reassigned or removed.

title: Evidence-Based Actions
content: Consequential actions require policy-supported evidence. Before taking any action that modifies order status, inventory, or assignments, the system must cite the specific evidence and applicable policy.

title: Tool Failure Handling
content: A failed tool call does not mean that the requested action succeeded. If a tool returns an error, the system must report the failure accurately and must not claim the action was successful.

title: Unsupported Action Restriction
content: If no applicable policy exists for a proposed action, do not perform unsupported consequential actions. Escalate to a human supervisor instead.
